# Detailing on Demand (DTailWash)

> Bilingual (English/Spanish) mobile car detailing marketplace serving Miami-Dade County, Florida. Customers book vetted, insured independent detailers who come to their home or office; contractors receive jobs and get paid through the platform.

## Company

- Service area: Miami-Dade County (Miami, Miami Beach, Hialeah, Coral Gables, Doral, Kendall, Homestead)
- Languages: English and Spanish, fully bilingual site and booking flow
- Services: Express Detail, Interior Detail, Exterior Detail, Full Detail

## Pages

- [Homepage (English)](https://dtailwash.com/en): Overview of services, pricing, and booking
- [Homepage (Spanish)](https://dtailwash.com/es): Resumen de servicios, precios y reservas
- [Book a detail](https://dtailwash.com/en/booking/select): Start a booking
- [Contractors](https://dtailwash.com/en/contractors): Information for detailers who want to join the platform
